D5/S3/Quantum/ShorCountingMarginal.qpe_a.signature: theorem qpe_arbitrary_phase_lower_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (θ : ℝ) (b : Fin N) (hnear : Nearest N θ b) : 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 ≤ probability N θ b

D5/S3/Quantum/ShorCountingMarginal.shor_.signature: theorem shor_distribution_normalized (n : ℕ) : (∑ y : Fin (2 ^ n), normSquared (runQPE c.modularOperator n c.input y)) = 1

D5/S3/Quantum/ShorCountingMarginal.shor_.name: QuantumShorOrderFindingCore.Parameters.shor_mixture_peak_lower_bound

D5/S3/Quantum/ShorCountingMarginal.shor_.name: QuantumShorOrderFindingCore.Parameters.shor_qpe_probability_mixture
D5/S3/Quantum/ShorCountingMarginal.shor_.signature: theorem shor_qpe_probability_mixture (n : ℕ) (y : Fin (2 ^ n)) : normSquared (runQPE c.modularOperator n c.input y) = (c.period : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ s : Fin c.period, probability (2 ^ n) (s.val / c.period) y
